earlyShellWrappers.note: Windows PowerShell formats native stderr Cargo progress as NativeCommandError records. Early wrappers did not explicitly exit with LASTEXITCODE. Complete successful test-binary/doc-test summaries are retained, without removing those shell artifacts.

workspace: The one final workspace command explicitly saves and exits with Cargo LASTEXITCODE; use workspace-counts.json and its complete log for the process verdict.
